bonafide_certificate.description: Certificate verifying current student enrollment at DTU.
required_documents: Completed Bonafide Application Form (Common Application Form)
bonafide_certificate.notes: Specify reason (scholarship, visa, or internship) in the form.

transcript_request.description: Official signed transcripts for higher education or employment verification.
transcript_request.fee: ₹500 per official set (Payable via Bank Challan at SBI DTU Branch)
required_documents: Photocopies of all semester grade cards
Payment receipt (DTU Bank Challan stamped copy)
transcript_request.notes: Direct overseas university dispatch available with postal envelope details.

duplicate_id_card.description: Reissue of lost, damaged, or stolen DTU Student ID card.
duplicate_id_card.fee: ₹500 (Payable via DTU Bank Challan at SBI DTU Branch)
required_documents: ID Card Reissue Application Form (Common Application Form)
Delhi Police Online Lost Report (e-FIR/NCR receipt)
Fee payment receipt (₹500 stamped SBI Bank Challan)
duplicate_id_card.notes: File free online police report at https://lostfound.delhipolice.gov.in/ (No police station visit needed). Fee is strictly ₹500.

fee_slip_request.description: Official receipt of semester academic fee payment.
fee_slip_request.notes: Also directly downloadable from the DTU ERP Portal under Fee History.

hostel_admission.description: Semester allotment for university residential hostels.
hostel_admission.fee: Hostel fee as per semester allotment notification
hostel_admission.notes: Allotment strictly as per distance & merit list.

hostel_leave.description: Permission for night-out or extended leave from hostel premises.
hostel_leave.notes: Leave exceeding 7 days requires DSW endorsement.

degree_certificate.description: Final convocation degree certificate upon course completion.
degree_certificate.fee: ₹1,000 (Only if applying for duplicate/special issuance; regular convocation degree is free after dues clearance)
degree_certificate.notes: Issued only after complete university No Dues clearance.

provisional_certificate.description: Interim certificate issued prior to the annual convocation.
provisional_certificate.notes: Valid until the official degree is conferred.

library_clearance.description: Clearance certificate confirming all books and fines are settled.
library_clearance.fee: Free (Clear outstanding book fines, if any)
library_clearance.notes: All borrowed books must be physically returned prior to stamp.

internship_letter.description: No Objection Certificate for attending summer/semester internships.
required_documents: Offer letter from the hiring organization
internship_letter.notes: Mandatory for academic credit or internships exceeding 4 weeks.

meeting_with_dean.description: Formal appointment request for academic grievance or administrative meeting.
required_documents: Common Application Form / Written application stating purpose
meeting_with_dean.notes: Confirmation slot will be notified via email.

grade_improvement.description: Application for marks re-checking or re-evaluation of answer scripts.
grade_improvement.fee: ₹1,000 per subject/paper (Payable via DTU Bank Challan)
grade_improvement.notes: Must apply within 15 days of result declaration. Results are final.

address_proof_request.description: Official institutional residence verification for passport, bank, or visa.
address_proof_request.notes: Available exclusively to resident students residing in DTU hostels.

official_leave_application.description: Attendance exemption when representing DTU in hackathons, sports, or conferences.
required_documents: Official invitation letter / event registration proof
official_leave_application.notes: Must be submitted at least 3 days prior to the event.

unknown_intent.description: Inquiry requiring general routing or manual helpdesk resolution.
unknown_intent.notes: Forwarded to the relevant department helpdesk.
